answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 4651 Country: United States of America Title: For the past 4-5 years i have been having very bad dreams about snakes. they are usually thrown at me by someone chasing me or following me and usually its either large ones or baby ones. when ever i dream about them and wake up in the middle of the night i cant go back to sleep, please if you can tell me what this means i really appreciate it. Question: asalamualakum, for the past 4-5 years i have been having very bad dreams about snakes. they are usually thrown at me by someone chasing me or following me and usually its either large ones or baby ones. when ever i dream about them and wake up in the middle of the night i cant go back to sleep, please if you can tell me what this means i really appreciate it. shukran. Answer ID: 4651 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1329=H/1429) The long hopes of worldly life, lust and satans appear in dreams like snakes; one can save himself from them by paying rights pertaining to Allah and His creature, engaging in prayers and forsaking sins. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
